text: FOL ::: ∀x (Waterfall(x) → (NaturalFeature(x) ∧ (∃y (WaterFlowsOverVerticalDrop(x, y) ∨ WaterFlowsOverSteepDrops(x, y))) ∧ (∃z (FoundInMountainousArea(x, z) ∨ FoundAlongRivers(x, z))))) ::: A waterfall is a natural feature where water flows over a vertical drop or a series of steep drops, often found in mountainous areas or along rivers.
